extracted.intended_audience: researchers, historians, librarians, and members of the public seeking digitized historical Associated Press clippings / microfilm
extracted.subtask_description: An Internet Archive item page giving descriptive metadata, OCR/scan details, and download/flagging options for a digitized microfilm issue of Associated Press clippings (Europe Disorders, Feb 1947).

rubrics_metrics.name: Item flagging categories
rubrics_metrics.description: Options presented to flag the item for policy-violating content: Graphic Violence; Explicit Sexual Content; Hate Speech; Misinformation/Disinformation; Marketing/Phishing/Advertising; Misleading/Inaccurate/Missing Metadata.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These are the explicit categories shown on the page for reporting/flagging the item. No additional scoring or examples are provided on the page.
